description: KPI baseline for P2P fake transport layer (Phase 5 §5.2)

fake_transport_send_p99_us.description: P99 latency for FakeTransport.send() with sync StreamController

fake_transport_100_frames_ms.description: Wall-clock time to send 100 frames through FakeTransport (must be < 5 ms)

jitter_wifigood_overhead_pct.description: CPU overhead of JitterTransport.wifiGood vs FakeTransport alone (must be < 10%)

lossy_100_frames_ms.description: Wall-clock time to send 100 frames through LossyTransport(lossRate=0)

transport_test_suite_total_ms.description: Total wall-clock time for all 180 transport tests (must be < 15 s)

thresholds.description: Any metric worse than baseline by >5% is a KPI regression requiring revert
